tasks.title: Develop Project Charter & Scope Definition
tasks.description: Author the formal project charter defining objectives, in/out-of-scope plants and lines, success criteria, budget envelope, executive sponsor, and the 64-week timeline across all 8 phases. Establish the single source of truth for scope decisions.
tasks.deliverables: Approved Project Charter | Scope statement | In/out-of-scope boundary map
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Charter signed by executive sponsor and plant leadership | Scope boundaries explicitly enumerated | Success metrics quantified

tasks.title: Conduct Stakeholder Mapping & RACI
tasks.description: Identify all stakeholders across IT, OT, production, quality, engineering, finance, and vendor ecosystem. Build a RACI matrix covering OT/IT governance decisions, change authority, and escalation paths.
tasks.deliverables: Stakeholder register | Power/interest grid | RACI matrix
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Every workstream has a single accountable owner | OT and IT decision rights are explicitly separated | Escalation path to steering committee documented

tasks.title: Execute 10-Dimension Readiness Diagnostic
tasks.description: Run the structured readiness diagnostic across strategy, governance, OT maturity, connectivity, data, analytics, cybersecurity, workforce, change capacity, and ROI. Score each dimension and benchmark against Industry 4.0 maturity.
tasks.deliverables: Readiness diagnostic report | Maturity heatmap | Gap-to-target analysis
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All 10 dimensions scored with evidence | Heatmap reviewed with sponsor | Top-5 gaps translated into initiative backlog

tasks.title: Develop Business Case & ROI Model
tasks.description: Quantify the financial case: yield uplift, OEE gain, downtime reduction, scrap reduction, energy savings, and labor efficiency. Build a phased ROI model with payback period, NPV, and scaling economics across the full plant footprint.
tasks.deliverables: Business case document | ROI model (spreadsheet) | Payback & NPV summary
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Baseline metrics sourced from plant data | Benefit assumptions signed off by finance and plant leadership | Payback period within sponsor threshold

tasks.title: Define Target Operating Model & Governance
tasks.description: Define the future operating model for the converged IT/OT organization, including a data office, OT cybersecurity function, and a cross-functional change board. Clarify decision rights between corporate IT, plant OT, and the new digital team.
tasks.deliverables: Target operating model | Governance charter | Decision-rights matrix
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Operating model reviewed by CIO and plant leadership | Clear ownership for data, security, and platforms | No decision-rights overlaps remain

tasks.title: Prepare Partner/Vendor RFP & Longlist
tasks.description: Draft RFPs for edge gateways, IIoT sensors, OT security appliances, the historian/data platform, edge compute, vision systems, and the system integrator. Build a longlist of qualified vendors per category.
tasks.deliverables: RFP documents per category | Vendor longlist | Evaluation scorecard
tasks.acceptance_criteria: RFPs reference architecture and IEC 62443 requirements | At least 3 vendors shortlisted per category | Evaluation criteria weighted and approved

tasks.title: Establish PMO, Cadence & Reporting
tasks.description: Stand up the engagement PMO: RAID log, status reporting, steering committee cadence, risk review, change control process, and the document/quality management system for deliverables.
tasks.deliverables: PMO handbook | Reporting templates | RAID log | Steering committee schedule
tasks.acceptance_criteria: First steering committee held | RAID log populated | Reporting cadence live

tasks.title: Align Maturity to AI-Native Roadmap & Quick Wins
tasks.description: Map the diagnostic maturity to the AI-Native stages (Curious → Aware → Capable → Advanced → Native) and sequence quick wins, the 90-day pilot, and the multi-phase roadmap with ROI projections.
tasks.deliverables: Phased roadmap | Quick-win backlog | AI-Native maturity trajectory
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Roadmap maps phases to weeks | Pilot line selected with sponsor sign-off | Quick wins scoped to deliver value within 90 days

tasks.title: Asset Inventory per Production Line
tasks.description: Walk every production line and catalog each asset: machines, cells, PLCs, drives, HMIs, instruments, and existing sensors. Capture make/model, age, criticality, and connectivity status for each.
tasks.deliverables: Asset register per line | Criticality classification | Connectivity status per asset
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 100% of in-scope assets recorded | Each asset has criticality and connectivity fields populated | Register reconciled with plant maintenance system

tasks.title: OT/IT Systems Audit
tasks.description: Audit existing OT and IT systems: SCADA, MES, ERP, QMS, CMMS, historians, and standalone spreadsheets. Document versions, patch levels, integration points, and known gaps.
tasks.deliverables: Systems inventory | Integration map | Version & patch-level register
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All production-relevant systems captured | Integration points and data flows documented | End-of-life systems flagged

tasks.title: Connectivity Survey (Wired/Wireless/Fiber)
tasks.description: Survey existing connectivity across the plant: Ethernet drops, industrial switches, fiber runs, wireless coverage, and RF environment. Identify dark spots and capacity constraints for new IIoT traffic.
tasks.deliverables: Connectivity survey report | Coverage heat map | Capacity gap list
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All production areas surveyed | Coverage gaps mapped to assets | Capacity estimates validated against planned traffic

tasks.title: Sensor & Instrumentation Gap Analysis
tasks.description: Compare required measurements (vibration, temperature, current/energy, vision) against installed instrumentation per critical asset. Quantify the sensor gap and propose instrumentation per asset class.
tasks.deliverables: Sensor gap analysis | Instrumentation proposal per asset class | Estimated sensor count
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Gap tied to analytics use cases | Sensor types specified per measurement | Estimates feed procurement plan

tasks.title: SCADA/HMI/PLC Protocol Capture
tasks.description: Capture the exact industrial protocols and data points in use: Modbus TCP/RTU, Profinet, EtherNet/IP, OPC DA, proprietary vendor protocols. Record register maps and tag lists for bridging.
tasks.deliverables: Protocol inventory | Register/tag map per PLC | Proprietary protocol notes
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Every in-scope PLC protocol documented | Tag lists exported and version-controlled | Proprietary protocols flagged for vendor engagement

tasks.title: ISA-95 Data Model & Object Definition
tasks.description: Design the ISA-95 aligned data model defining enterprise/site/area/line/cell/equipment hierarchy and equipment capability objects. Establish the canonical naming for assets, lines, and products.
tasks.deliverables: ISA-95 hierarchy definition | Equipment object model | Canonical naming convention
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Hierarchy covers all in-scope lines | Object model reviewed by OT and data teams | Naming convention approved

tasks.title: OT Cybersecurity Baseline Assessment
tasks.description: Assess current OT cybersecurity posture against IEC 62443: zone/conduit definitions, access controls, patching, remote access, and incident response readiness. Identify critical exposures.
tasks.deliverables: OT security baseline report | Exposure register | IEC 62443 gap analysis
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All OT zones assessed | Critical exposures prioritized | Findings validated with plant OT team

tasks.title: Network Topology Mapping & Documentation
tasks.description: Produce current-state network topology for OT and IT networks: switches, routers, firewalls, VLANs, and interconnections. Document IP addressing and segmentation as-is.
tasks.deliverables: As-is network topology diagrams | IP/VLAN inventory | Firewall rule inventory
tasks.acceptance_criteria: OT and IT networks fully diagrammed | Interconnection points identified | Topology validated against live configuration

tasks.title: Power & Environmental Survey for Edge Sites
tasks.description: Survey candidate edge cabinet locations for power (UPS, redundancy), cooling, dust/vibration exposure, and physical security. Confirm suitability for industrial edge compute and gateways.
tasks.deliverables: Edge site survey report | Power/cooling readiness per site | Recommended cabinet locations
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each site meets UPS and cooling thresholds | Environmental ratings matched to conditions | Locations approved by plant facilities

tasks.title: Production Process & Sequence-of-Operations Mapping
tasks.description: Map the production process and sequence of operations for pilot lines end-to-end: stations, cycle times, buffers, manual steps, and quality checks. Identify where data and automation interventions fit.
tasks.deliverables: Process flow diagrams | Sequence-of-operations documentation | Cycle-time baseline
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Pilot line fully mapped | Bottlenecks identified | Mapping validated by line supervisors

tasks.title: Data Source Catalog & Tag Naming Convention
tasks.description: Compile a catalog of all data sources and define a consistent tag naming convention (ISA-95 aligned) for time-series data, events, and batch records across lines.
tasks.deliverables: Data source catalog | Tag naming convention | Tag dictionary template
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Convention covers measurement, equipment, line, and unit | Catalog reconciled with PLC tag lists | Convention approved by data and OT leads

tasks.title: Brownfield Constraints & Production Window Analysis
tasks.description: Identify brownfield constraints affecting deployment: limited shutdown windows, hazardous areas, and cleanroom/ESD requirements. Define the safe production windows for OT changes per line.
tasks.deliverables: Constraints register | Production window calendar | Deployment sequencing plan
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Shutdown windows mapped per line | Hazardous-area constraints documented | Sequencing plan approved by production

tasks.title: Define Edge/Cloud Reference Architecture
tasks.description: Design the reference architecture balancing edge compute (low-latency control, vision inference) and cloud (data lake, ML training, enterprise analytics). Define compute placement tiers and data residency.
tasks.deliverables: Edge/cloud reference architecture | Compute tier definitions | Data residency policy
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Architecture supports real-time and batch workloads | Latency budgets defined per tier | Architecture reviewed by steering committee

tasks.title: Design IT/OT Converged Network Architecture
tasks.description: Design the converged network architecture using IEC 62443 zones and conduits, deterministic industrial networking where needed, and segmentation between cell, line, site, and enterprise layers.
tasks.deliverables: Converged network design | Zone/conduit diagram | Segmentation plan
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Design isolates safety and control traffic | Bandwidth and latency requirements met | Design validated by OT and network teams

tasks.title: Develop Security Blueprint (IEC 62443 Zones & Conduits)
tasks.description: Produce the OT security blueprint defining zones, conduits, security levels, access control, key/PKI management, and secure remote access aligned to IEC 62443-3-3 target security levels.
tasks.deliverables: Security blueprint | Target security level definitions | Access & PKI design
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Target security levels justified per zone | Blueprint addresses remote access and key management | CISO sign-off obtained

tasks.title: Design Data Platform Architecture (Historian, Lake, Edge)
tasks.description: Design the data platform: time-series historian, object storage data lake, edge buffering, cataloging, and access layers. Define retention tiers, compression, and ingestion patterns.
tasks.deliverables: Data platform architecture | Retention & tiering policy | Ingestion pattern reference
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Architecture supports historian, lake, and edge tiers | Retention meets analytics and compliance needs | Scalability validated for full plant footprint

tasks.title: Design MES Integration Architecture
tasks.description: Define how the data platform integrates with MES: order dispatch, production status, equipment status, and batch records. Choose integration patterns (OPC UA, REST, message bus) and data ownership boundaries.
tasks.deliverables: MES integration design | Interface control documents | Data ownership matrix
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Integration patterns defined per interface | No data ownership conflicts with MES | Design reviewed with MES vendor/admin

tasks.title: Design QMS Integration Architecture
tasks.description: Define integration with the QMS for inspection results, defect codes, non-conformance, and CAPA. Ensure bidirectional flow for closed-loop quality and traceability.
tasks.deliverables: QMS integration design | Defect data model | Closed-loop quality workflow
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Defect data model aligned with QMS | Closed-loop quality workflow validated | Quality head review complete

tasks.title: Technology Stack Selection & Vendor Shortlist
tasks.description: Select the technology stack for historian, data lake, message bus, edge runtime, ML platform, and dashboards. Finalize the vendor shortlist aligned to the RFP evaluation.
tasks.deliverables: Technology stack decision | Vendor shortlist with rationale | Build-vs-buy assessment
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Stack meets architecture and security requirements | Decisions traceable to evaluation scorecard | Licensing implications documented

tasks.title: Define Data Governance & Master Data Model
tasks.description: Establish data governance: data ownership, quality rules, master data for assets/products/materials, and lifecycle management. Define stewardship roles and metrics.
tasks.deliverables: Data governance framework | Master data model | Data stewardship matrix
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Ownership defined per domain | Quality rules measurable | Master data reconciled with MES/ERP

tasks.title: Define Identity, Access & PKI Architecture
tasks.description: Define identity and access management across IT/OT: RBAC, device identities, certificate authority/PKI for OPC UA and mutual TLS, and secrets management for edge devices.
tasks.deliverables: IAM architecture | PKI/certificate design | Secrets management design
tasks.acceptance_criteria: RBAC roles map to job functions | PKI covers OPC UA and edge devices | Key rotation policy defined

tasks.title: Design High Availability, DR & Backup Strategy
tasks.description: Define HA and disaster recovery for edge, historian, data lake, and integration services: redundancy, failover, RTO/RPO targets, and tested backup/restore procedures.
tasks.deliverables: HA/DR design | RTO/RPO targets | Backup & restore runbook
tasks.acceptance_criteria: RTO/RPO targets agreed with operations | No single point of failure on critical path | Backup restore procedure documented

tasks.title: Define OPC UA/MQTT Information Model & Namespace
tasks.description: Define the OPC UA information model and companion specs, MQTT topic structure, and payload schema (e.g., Sparkplug B) for normalized data exchange from edge to platform.
tasks.deliverables: OPC UA information model | MQTT topic taxonomy | Payload schema spec
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Model covers all asset classes | Topic structure supports scalability | Schema reviewed by OT and data teams

tasks.title: Architecture Review Board Sign-off & ADRs
tasks.description: Convene the Architecture Review Board to validate the end-to-end design, capture architecture decision records (ADRs), and obtain formal sign-off before procurement and build.
tasks.deliverables: Signed architecture package | ADR set | Open-items/action log
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All ADRs documented | ARB sign-off recorded | Critical open items have owners and dates

tasks.title: Issue RFP & Evaluate Edge Gateway Vendors
tasks.description: Issue the edge gateway RFP, evaluate responses against protocol support, ruggedization, security, and vendor support, and recommend the selected gateway (e.g., Moxa, Advantech).
tasks.deliverables: RFP responses evaluated | Vendor recommendation memo | Edge gateway BoM
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Recommendation traceable to scorecard | Protocol and ruggedization requirements met | BoM matches line counts

tasks.title: Procure IIoT Sensors (Vibration, Thermal, Energy)
tasks.description: Procure IIoT sensors for vibration, temperature, and energy/current measurement. Validate accuracy, range, connectivity, and environmental ratings against the gap analysis.
tasks.deliverables: Sensor purchase orders | Sensor BoM | Calibration certificates requested
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Sensors meet accuracy and rating specs | Quantities match gap analysis | Lead times within phase window

tasks.title: Procure OT Security Appliances (Firewall/DMZ)
tasks.description: Procure OT-grade firewalls and DMZ appliances supporting protocol-aware inspection and IEC 62443 conformance. Confirm throughput and inspection depth.
tasks.deliverables: Security appliance purchase orders | Appliance BoM | Throughput validation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Appliances meet throughput and inspection specs | Vendor provides IEC 62443 conformance evidence | Quantities match zone design

tasks.title: Procure Historian & Platform Licenses
tasks.description: Procure the time-series historian, data lake/cloud, and platform licenses. Negotiate tag-based and core-based licensing to avoid cost escalation at scale.
tasks.deliverables: Historian & platform contracts | License schedule | Commercial terms summary
tasks.acceptance_criteria: License model supports full-plant scale | Growth pricing capped | Contract executed

tasks.title: Procure Edge Compute & GPU Hardware
tasks.description: Procure industrial edge servers with GPU acceleration for vision inference and edge analytics. Confirm cooling, ruggedization, and compute specifications.
tasks.deliverables: Edge compute purchase orders | GPU edge BoM | Environmental spec confirmation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Compute meets inference latency targets | Cooling/ruggedization fit confirmed | Quantities match edge site plan

tasks.title: Procure Vision Systems & Cameras
tasks.description: Procure industrial cameras, lighting, and optics for vision QA (e.g., electroluminescence imaging for solar cells/modules). Confirm resolution, frame rate, and lighting compatibility.
tasks.deliverables: Vision system purchase orders | Camera/lighting BoM | Optical spec confirmation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Cameras meet resolution/frame-rate specs | Lighting validated for defect types | Quantities match inspection stations

tasks.title: Select System Integrator (SI) & Contract
tasks.description: Select the system integrator with proven Industry 4.0 and OT credentials, define the SOW, and execute the contract. Validate references and OT-specific certifications.
tasks.deliverables: SI selection memo | Executed SOW/contract | Reference checks complete
tasks.acceptance_criteria: SI references verified | SOW covers scope with minimal gaps | Contract executed with milestone payments

tasks.title: Negotiate Software & Cloud Subscriptions
tasks.description: Negotiate enterprise software and cloud subscriptions: commit levels, scaling flexibility, and renewal protection to control multi-year cost escalation.
tasks.deliverables: Negotiated subscription terms | Cost model | Renewal & exit clauses
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Commit levels match roadmap demand | Renewal caps documented | Exit/portability clauses included

tasks.title: Logistics, Customs & Warehousing Plan
tasks.description: Plan inbound logistics for industrial hardware: lead times, customs clearance for imported goods, warehousing, and staging sequence aligned to deployment windows.
tasks.deliverables: Logistics & customs plan | Warehousing/staging plan | Delivery schedule
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Lead times mapped to phase windows | Customs requirements addressed | Staging sequence matches deployment plan

tasks.title: Procurement Acceptance & Asset Register
tasks.description: Receive, inspect, and accept all procured hardware against POs. Record serial numbers, warranty, and firmware baseline in the asset register before deployment.
tasks.deliverables: Goods-receipt acceptance records | Updated asset register | Warranty & firmware baseline
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All POs reconciled with receipts | Each device recorded with serial and firmware | Defective units flagged and replaced

tasks.title: Install & Terminate Physical Network (OFC/Copper)
tasks.description: Install and terminate fiber and copper cabling per the converged network design, including cable certification and labeling for all OT and IT runs.
tasks.deliverables: Installed & terminated cabling | Cable certification records | As-built labeling
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All runs certified to spec | Labeling matches documentation | No faulty terminations

tasks.title: Configure VLANs & OT/IT Segmentation
tasks.description: Configure VLANs and segmentation across switches per the zone/conduit design, isolating control, safety, IIoT, and enterprise traffic.
tasks.deliverables: VLAN configuration | Segmentation test results | Switch configuration backup
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Traffic isolation verified per zone | No unintended lateral movement | Configurations backed up

tasks.title: Deploy OT/IT DMZ & Firewalls
tasks.description: Deploy the OT/IT DMZ and configure OT-grade firewalls with protocol-aware rules aligned to IEC 62443. Enforce deny-by-default between zones.
tasks.deliverables: Deployed DMZ | Firewall rule set | Rule justification log
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Deny-by-default enforced | Every rule has a documented owner and justification | DMZ passes validation

tasks.title: Commission Industrial Edge Gateways
tasks.description: Commission edge gateways: firmware baseline, secure configuration, certificate enrollment, and connection to southbound devices and northbound platform.
tasks.deliverables: Commissioned gateways | Secure configuration baseline | Gateway health checks
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All gateways online with hardened config | Certificates enrolled | Southbound connectivity validated

tasks.title: Implement Protocol Bridging (Modbus/Profinet to OPC UA/MQTT)
tasks.description: Configure protocol bridging on edge gateways to translate legacy protocols (Modbus, Profinet, EtherNet/IP) to normalized OPC UA/MQTT payloads per the information model.
tasks.deliverables: Protocol bridge configurations | Normalized tag mappings | Validation captures
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Bridged values match source registers | All mapped tags flowing northbound | Bridge latency within budget

tasks.title: Install IIoT Sensors on Production Lines
tasks.description: Install IIoT sensors (vibration, thermal, energy) on critical assets per the instrumentation plan, during approved production windows, with calibration verification.
tasks.deliverables: Installed sensors | Mounting & routing records | Calibration verification
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All planned sensors installed | Calibration verified against reference | No production disruption during install

tasks.title: Commission Edge Compute & GPU Servers
tasks.description: Commission industrial edge compute and GPU servers: OS hardening, container runtime, GPU drivers, and connection to platform and vision workloads.
tasks.deliverables: Commissioned edge servers | Hardened OS & runtime | GPU validation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Servers online and hardened | GPU inference validated | Compute reachable from platform

tasks.title: Configure Time Sync (PTP Grandmaster/NTP)
tasks.description: Deploy PTP grandmaster and NTP hierarchy to synchronize time across PLCs, gateways, edge compute, and platform for accurate event correlation and traceability.
tasks.deliverables: PTP/NTP configuration | Time-sync verification report | Stratum/accuracy log
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All devices synchronized within accuracy target | Drift within tolerance | Failover grandmaster validated

tasks.title: Wireless & Sensor Network Commissioning
tasks.description: Commission wireless and sensor networks (industrial Wi-Fi, wireless sensor gateways), validate coverage, roaming, and reliability across the plant floor.
tasks.deliverables: Commissioned wireless network | Coverage test results | Roaming validation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Coverage meets sensor density needs | Roaming seamless for mobile assets | Reliability within target

tasks.title: Network Segmentation Validation & Internal Pen Test
tasks.description: Validate segmentation end-to-end and run an internal penetration test to confirm no unintended paths between OT zones, DMZ, and enterprise.
tasks.deliverables: Segmentation validation report | Internal pen test report | Remediation log
tasks.acceptance_criteria: No critical segmentation bypass | Findings remediated or risk-accepted | Report signed by security lead

tasks.title: Establish Secure Remote Access (Jump Host/VPN)
tasks.description: Stand up secure remote access for vendors and support: hardened jump hosts, MFA, session recording, and time-bound access aligned to IEC 62443.
tasks.deliverables: Remote access solution | Access policy & runbook | Session recording configured
tasks.acceptance_criteria: MFA enforced on all remote sessions | Sessions recorded and auditable | Access is time-bound and approved

tasks.title: Validate Edge-to-Cloud Connectivity
tasks.description: Validate resilient edge-to-cloud connectivity, including failover behavior and store-and-forward buffering during link interruption.
tasks.deliverables: Connectivity validation report | Failover test results | Buffering verification
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Failover within target | No data loss during simulated outage | Store-and-forward recovers gracefully

tasks.title: Network Performance & Latency Baseline
tasks.description: Baseline network performance and latency for critical IIoT and control traffic, and confirm measurements against architecture latency budgets.
tasks.deliverables: Performance baseline report | Latency budget reconciliation | Optimization recommendations
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Latency within architecture budget | Throughput meets projected load | Baseline documented for future comparison

tasks.title: Spare Parts & Field Tooling Staging
tasks.description: Stage spare gateways, sensors, optics, and field tooling for rapid swap-out. Define min/max stock and RMA process with vendors.
tasks.deliverables: Spare parts inventory | Min/max stock levels | RMA process
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Spares cover critical single points | Stock levels set | RMA process documented

tasks.title: Infrastructure Commissioning Sign-off
tasks.description: Consolidate infrastructure commissioning evidence and obtain operations and security sign-off that the network, edge, and IoT layers are production-ready.
tasks.deliverables: Commissioning evidence pack | Sign-off record | Open-issues log
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All commissioning checks passed | Operations and security sign-off recorded | Open issues have remediation owners

tasks.title: Deploy Time-Series Historian
tasks.description: Deploy and configure the time-series historian with high availability, tag load from the data source catalog, compression, and retention per the data platform design.
tasks.deliverables: Deployed historian | Tag configuration | Retention & compression policy
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Historian ingesting all pilot tags | HA validated | Retention policy enforced

tasks.title: Provision Data Lake & Storage Tiers
tasks.description: Provision the data lake with hot/warm/cold storage tiers, partitioning, and lifecycle policies. Establish cataloging and access controls.
tasks.deliverables: Provisioned data lake | Storage tier policies | Catalog & access controls
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tiers and lifecycle policies active | Access controls enforced | Catalog populated

tasks.title: Develop Data Pipelines (Machine to Historian to Lake)
tasks.description: Develop and operationalize data pipelines from machine/gateway to historian to data lake, including transformation, contextualization, and orchestration with monitoring.
tasks.deliverables: Operational pipelines | Contextualization logic | Pipeline monitoring
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Pipelines running with SLAs | Data contextualized with line/shift/product | Failures alerted and recoverable

tasks.title: Build Real-Time Control Tower Dashboard (OEE, Yield, Downtime)
tasks.description: Build the real-time control tower dashboard showing OEE, throughput, yield, and downtime by line/shift, with drill-down to asset and reason codes.
tasks.deliverables: Control tower dashboard | OEE/yield/downtime calculations | Drill-down views
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Dashboard refreshes near real-time | OEE methodology validated | Usable by plant leadership

tasks.title: Implement MES Integration (Orders, Dispatch, Status)
tasks.description: Implement MES integration for production orders, dispatch, equipment status, and batch records using the agreed integration patterns.
tasks.deliverables: MES integration interfaces | Interface tests | Reconciliation reports
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Order/status sync validated end-to-end | No data ownership conflicts | Error handling and retries in place

tasks.title: Implement QMS Integration (Defects, Inspections)
tasks.description: Implement QMS integration to receive inspection results and defect codes and feed closed-loop quality actions back to the line.
tasks.deliverables: QMS integration interfaces | Defect data flow | Closed-loop tests
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Defects flow bidirectionally | Closed-loop actions traceable | Quality head review complete

tasks.title: Enable End-to-End Traceability (Module Genealogy)
tasks.description: Enable end-to-end traceability capturing module/component genealogy from material through each process step, supporting recall and quality analysis.
tasks.deliverables: Traceability data model | Genealogy records | Trace query capability
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Genealogy reconstructable per module | Trace queries return within target | Recall scenario validated

tasks.title: Integrate Warehouse/WMS & Material Flow
tasks.description: Integrate WMS to surface material availability and consumption, linking material lots to production for complete traceability and inventory accuracy.
tasks.deliverables: WMS integration interfaces | Material linkage | Inventory accuracy report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Material lots linked to production | Inventory accuracy improved | No orphan material records

tasks.title: Implement Shift/Line/Asset Data Context Layer
tasks.description: Build the context layer that enriches raw telemetry with shift, line, asset, product, and order context to power analytics and dashboards.
tasks.deliverables: Context layer | Enrichment rules | Context quality checks
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All telemetry contextualized | Context accurate against MES/shift data | Quality checks pass

tasks.title: Configure Data Quality Rules & Exception Handling
tasks.description: Configure data quality rules for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and plausibility, with exception handling and steward workflows for bad data.
tasks.deliverables: Data quality rule set | Exception handling workflow | DQ scorecards
tasks.acceptance_criteria: DQ rules active on key tags | Exceptions routed to stewards | DQ scorecards published

tasks.title: Develop Alarm & Event Management
tasks.description: Develop alarm and event management with rationalized alarm priorities, escalation, and an audit trail to avoid alarm flooding on the floor.
tasks.deliverables: Alarm management system | Alarm rationalization | Escalation matrix
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Alarms prioritized and deduplicated | No alarm flooding in tests | Full audit trail captured

tasks.title: Build Mobile/Operator HMI Dashboards
tasks.description: Build mobile and operator-facing HMI dashboards giving line operators real-time status, alerts, and guidance at the workstation.
tasks.deliverables: Operator dashboards | Mobile app/views | Usability test results
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Dashboards usable on the floor | Latency acceptable to operators | Positive operator feedback

tasks.title: Establish APIs for Downstream (ERP/Analytics) Consumers
tasks.description: Publish governed APIs for ERP, finance, and analytics consumers to access production data with authentication, rate limiting, and versioning.
tasks.deliverables: Published APIs | API documentation | Access governance
tasks.acceptance_criteria: APIs authenticated and rate-limited | Documentation complete | Downstream consumers onboarded

tasks.title: Data Platform Performance Tuning & Scalability Test
tasks.description: Tune the data platform for performance and run scalability tests simulating full-plant tag volumes and analytics loads.
tasks.deliverables: Tuning report | Scalability test results | Capacity recommendations
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Performance meets SLA at projected load | No bottlenecks at full-plant scale | Capacity plan documented

tasks.title: Platform UAT with Operations
tasks.description: Run user acceptance testing with plant operations, quality, and maintenance users to validate dashboards, traceability, and integrations against real scenarios.
tasks.deliverables: UAT plan & scripts | UAT results log | Defect/remediation list
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All critical UAT scenarios pass | Defects resolved or risk-accepted | Operations sign-off recorded

tasks.title: Develop Computer Vision Defect Detection (EL Micro-Cracks, Solder)
tasks.description: Develop computer vision models to detect defects from electroluminescence and visual imaging — e.g., solar cell micro-cracks and solder defects — with edge inference.
tasks.deliverables: Trained vision models | Labeled dataset | Edge inference pipeline
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Precision/recall meet target on holdout | Inference latency within budget | False-negative rate on critical defects below threshold

tasks.title: Build Predictive Maintenance Models (Vibration/Thermal)
tasks.description: Build predictive maintenance models from vibration and thermal data to forecast bearing and equipment degradation, with lead time for planned intervention.
tasks.deliverables: PdM models | Feature engineering pipeline | Validation report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Models predict failures with usable lead time | Validation on historical events | Performance documented

tasks.title: Develop Yield Analytics & Root-Cause Diagnostics
tasks.description: Develop yield analytics and root-cause diagnostics that correlate process parameters, material lots, and environmental factors to yield loss drivers.
tasks.deliverables: Yield analytics models | Root-cause diagnostic dashboards | Driver attribution
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Top yield-loss drivers identified | Attribution validated with process engineers | Insights actionable on the floor

tasks.title: Build Digital Twin of Pilot Line
tasks.description: Build a digital twin of the pilot line mirroring asset state, process flows, and performance, enabling simulation and what-if analysis.
tasks.deliverables: Digital twin model | Simulation scenarios | Validation report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Twin reflects live line state | What-if scenarios produce realistic outputs | Twin validated against measured behavior

tasks.title: Implement Closed-Loop Control (AI Adjusts Process Setpoints)
